title: Memphis, TN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Memphis, TN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Memphis is a city in TN with a population of 621,056. Birthplace of rock ’n’ roll with BBQ, blues on Beale Street, and no state income tax. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
